title: Neural Network-Based Modeling of Hysteretic Systems: From Prandtl and Preisach Neural Networks to Neuro-Madelung and Neuroplastic Continuous Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.23240v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Hysteresis is a complex nonlinear phenomenon characterized by memory dependence, path dependence, and, in many physical systems, degradation, non-congruency, asymmetry, and rate dependence. This review examines the development and capabilities of Prandtl neural networks (PNNs), Preisach neural networks (PreisachNNs), generalized Prandtl neural networks (GPNNs), the neuro-Madelung model (NMM), extended Preisach neural networks (EPNNs), and dynamic plastic continuous neural networks (DPCNNs). Particular attention is given to their mechanisms for representing memory, network architectures, activation functions, training algorithms, treatment of deterioration and rate dependence, and applications to nonlinear structural and material systems. The PNN introduced hysteretic memory directly into neural activation through stop operators and demonstrated accurate nonlinear dynamic analysis of structures. translated_title: 基于神经网络的迟滞系统建模：从Prandtl与Preisach神经网络到神经Madelung与神经塑性连续模型
translated_abstract: 迟滞是一种复杂的非线性现象，其特征为记忆依赖性和路径依赖性，并且在许多物理系统中还表现出退化、非一致性、不对称性和速率依赖性。本综述考察了Prandtl神经网络、Preisach神经网络、广义Prandtl神经网络、神经Madelung模型、扩展Preisach神经网络以及动态塑性连续神经网络的发展历程与能力。综述特别关注了这些模型表征记忆的机制、网络架构、激活函数、训练算法、对退化和速率依赖性的处理方式，以及它们在非线性结构与材料系统中的应用。PNN通过停止算子将迟滞记忆直接引入神经激活过程，并展示了对结构进行精确非线性动力分析的能力。Preisach神经网络随后在此基础上进行了扩展。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了从PNN、PreisachNN到GPNN、NMM、EPNN和DPCNN等一系列基于神经网络的迟滞系统建模方法的发展，涵盖其记忆表征机制、网络架构、训练算法及在非线性结构与材料系统中的应用。
en_tdlr: This review systematically surveys the evolution of neural network-based hysteresis modeling approaches—from PNNs and PreisachNNs to GPNNs, NMM, EPNNs, and DPCNNs—covering their memory representation mechanisms, architectures, training algorithms, and applications to nonlinear structural and material systems.
